decisions.reason: The printer is close to the firm's core coding and marking expertise, and with strong in-house R&D the firm is well placed to learn from early market feedback and improve it rather than withdraw it.
This software module directly builds on the established offer and fits the firm's move toward digitalization and traceability, so its related knowledge base makes continued commercialization likely.
An inkjet coder for non-absorbent surfaces extends the firm's existing printing and ink capabilities in a familiar application area, making retention more likely than exit.
